card.title: Nintendo Switch Error Code: 2101-0001 Repair

claims.statement: Switch error 2101-0001 is an I2C error with M92T36 (USB-C PD controller), almost always both a port and M92T36 fault, often from bad cables, angled insertion or poor third-party accessories.

Lift the USB-C port (it has a hidden row of pins—trace damage is easy); check M92T36 caps for shorts and replace M92T36 even if it looks fine; check PI3USB's top cap on the other side and replace PI3USB if shorted.
Port removal used: no nozzle, 480 °C, ~40% airflow straight down, ~60 s, tap until free, wait 5–10 s more, then lift.
After repair test 15 V Nintendo and 5 V chargers on both cable orientations, docking and fast charge; advise replacing the customer's cable.

procedure: Check PI3USB top cap; replace PI3USB if shorted.
Test 15 V/5 V both sides, dock, fast charge, full system.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: The Switch USB-C port has a hidden pin row; forcing it off rips traces.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
